description: BeSpoke v2 slide pieces, 2 to 4 samples per decision. Option CSS uses only --role-* and palette variables; every color pair an option creates is listed in its pairs; excludes names options in the same group it can't be combined with. Decisions are emitted in listed order, so later decisions (usually layout) win. Read by bespoke/design-model.mjs and scripts/bespoke_roles.py.

roles.label: Sidebar
roles.note: The chapter list on every slide. Its text color is chosen for you.

roles.label: Title slide second color
roles.note: The gradient's second color and the split layout's right panel.

roles.label: Title text
roles.note: Large lettering on the title slide.

roles.label: Subtitle
roles.note: The line under the title, and the copyright line.

roles.label: Slide headings
roles.note: Headings on content slides and cards.

roles.label: Accent
roles.note: Rules, card edges, list arrows and the current chapter.

roles.label: Buttons
roles.note: Handout and video buttons. Their text color is chosen for you.

roles.label: Chapter divider background
roles.note: Behind each chapter's opening slide. Its text color is chosen for you.

options.label: Plain
options.css: .main { background-image: none; }

options.label: Dot grid
options.css: .main { background-image: radial-gradient(rgba(var(--role-accent-rgb), 0.14) 1px, transparent 1px); background-size: 16px 16px; }

options.label: Diagonal
options.css: .main { background-image: repeating-linear-gradient(45deg, rgba(var(--role-accent-rgb), 0.08) 0 1px, transparent 1px 14px); }

options.label: Crosshatch
options.css: .main { background-image: linear-gradient(rgba(var(--role-accent-rgb), 0.07) 1px, transparent 1px), linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(var(--role-accent-rgb), 0.07) 1px, transparent 1px); background-size: 24px 24px; }

options.label: Solid
options.css: .slide-title { background: var(--role-title-background); }

options.label: Gradient
options.css: .slide-title { background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--role-title-background), var(--role-title-background-end)); }

options.label: Light
Top corner
options.css:
.slide-title { position: relative; }
.slide-title .logo { position: absolute; top: 2rem; right: 2.5rem; max-width: 160px; margin: 0; }

options.label: Centered
options.css: .slide-title { align-items: center; text-align: center; }

options.label: Left
options.css: .slide-title { align-items: flex-start; text-align: left; padding-left: 7rem; }

options.label: Bottom left
options.css: .slide-title { align-items: flex-start; justify-content: flex-end; text-align: left; padding-left: 7rem; padding-bottom: 5rem; }

options.label: Split panels
Gradient
options.css: .slide-section, .slide-section[data-chapter-num] { background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--role-divider-background), var(--role-title-background-end)); }

options.label: Light
Hide
options.css: .slide-section::after { content: none; }

options.label: Left
options.css:
.slide-section { align-items: flex-start; text-align: left; padding-left: 8rem; }
.slide-section .section-circle { display: none; }

options.label: Band
Big number
Light
options.css: .slide-video { background: var(--role-content-background); }

options.label: Tinted
options.css: .slide-video { background: linear-gradient(170deg, rgba(var(--role-accent-rgb), 0.12), var(--role-content-background) 60%); }

options.label: Dark
options.css:
.slide-video { background: var(--role-divider-background); }
.slide-video h2 { color: var(--role-divider-background-ink); }

options.label: Accent frame
options.css: .video-container { border: 4px solid var(--role-accent); }

options.label: Large
options.css: .slide-video h2 { font-size: 2.8rem; }

options.label: Small caps
options.css: .slide-video h2 { font-size: 1.4rem; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.12em; }

options.label: Side by side
Title banner
options.css: .slide-video h2 { align-self: stretch; margin: 0 0 2rem; padding: 1rem 2rem; background: var(--role-button); color: var(--role-button-ink); border-radius: 8px; }

options.label: Left rail
options.css: .card, .card.gold-border { background: var(--role-content-background); border: 0; border-left: 6px solid var(--role-accent); box-shadow: 0 4px 14px rgba(0, 19, 63, 0.08); }

options.label: Outline
options.css: .card, .card.gold-border { background: var(--role-content-background); border: 2px solid var(--role-accent); }

options.label: Filled
options.css: .card, .card.gold-border { background: var(--muted); border: 0; }

options.label: Top band
options.css: .card, .card.gold-border { background: var(--role-content-background); border: 0; border-top: 6px solid var(--role-accent); border-radius: 4px 4px 12px 12px; box-shadow: 0 4px 14px rgba(0, 19, 63, 0.08); }

options.label: Three across
Rows
Numbered
Large
options.css:
.card h4 { font-size: 2rem; line-height: 1.15; }
.card { padding-top: 1.5rem; padding-bottom: 1.5rem; }

options.label: Small caps
options.css: .card h4 { font-size: 1.15rem; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.12em; }

options.label: Tinted
options.css: .card, .card.gold-border { background: rgba(var(--role-accent-rgb), 0.1); }

options.label: Bold
options.css:
.card, .card.gold-border { background: var(--role-button); }
.card h4, .card p, .card::before { color: var(--role-button-ink); }

options.label: Light
Tinted
Solid
options.css:
.activity-box { background: var(--role-accent); }
.activity-label, .activity-box p { color: var(--role-accent-ink); }

options.label: Heading font
options.css: .activity-label { font-family: var(--font-heading); font-size: 1.6rem; font-weight: 400; text-transform: none; letter-spacing: 0; }

options.label: Pill
options.css: .activity-label { display: inline-block; padding: 0.25rem 0.85rem; border-radius: 999px; background: var(--role-accent); color: var(--role-accent-ink); }

options.label: Box
options.css: .activity-box { border: 2px solid var(--role-accent); border-radius: 12px; }

options.label: Callout
options.css: .activity-box { border: 0; border-left: 6px solid var(--role-accent); border-radius: 0 12px 12px 0; }

options.label: Label banner
options.css:
.activity-box { border: 2px solid var(--role-accent); border-radius: 12px; padding-top: 0; overflow: hidden; }
.activity-label { display: block; margin: 0 -2rem 1rem; padding: 0.6rem 2rem; border-radius: 0; background: var(--role-accent); color: var(--role-accent-ink); }
